articles.title: Letter: Support the Street Tree Planting
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting. Please keep the street tree planting in the budget. Many of us on Carver Lane use it every week.

Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Carver Lane for 38 years, and I want to say what a difference the Stonebridge Trail Crew has made.
Agnes Kozak, Canal Park

articles.title: Lamar Kessler, 65, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Lamar Kessler for the many years of service to Stonebridge.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Cedar Hollow Garden Club in his or her name. Lamar Kessler died in July at home on Ingram Street, at the age of 65.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Stonebridge. Born in Stonebridge in the years after the war, Lamar Kessler spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Cedar Hollow Garden Club in his or her name.
